string.text: Force the classic Body Health System screen HUD on when you take limb damage, while a key is held, and/or while the inventory is open. Overrides hide / the stock BHS key while shown. Damage flashes fade in and out over 0.5s when possible. Set show duration to 0 to disable the damage trigger.
How long the BHS HUD stays visible after limb damage. Further hits refresh the timer. 0 = off.
Show the BHS HUD while this key is held. No key bound by default. Optional modifier below can reduce conflicts.
Keep the BHS HUD visible whenever your inventory is open.
